notes: Linux x64, macOS ARM64 and Windows x64 preview packages with GitHub Copilot subscription support; telemetry and remote diagnostic uploads are disabled.
Installs as codex. Internal package version matches the executable so normal background-server launch works.

macOS ARM64 was cross-compiled locally and has not been run on a Mac. Windows x64 was built on the local Windows host and passed version and Copilot login-help checks. Live account login/inference and a passing full workspace test suite remain unverified. Other architecture combinations are not published.

assets.name: zai-codex for Linux x64
assets.installNotes: Linux x64, glibc 2.39+, OpenSSL 3, libcap2, zlib, zstd and libtinfo6. Python 3.10+ is required for the installer. Run codex after installation. Unsigned preview; keep the complete bundle together. Alpine/musl is unsupported.

assets.name: zai-codex for macOS ARM64
assets.installNotes: Apple Silicon macOS 12+. Cross-compiled preview; native macOS execution has not been tested. Ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. Python 3.10+ is required for the installer. Keep the complete bundle together and follow macOS security prompts.

assets.name: zai-codex for Windows x64
assets.installNotes: Windows 10+ x64. Unsigned preview; follow Windows security prompts. Python 3.10+ is required for the installer. Keep the complete bundle together, then run codex.cmd from the launcher directory.
